info.description: Visitor comments on blog articles. Supports one level of nested replies via the 'parent' relation. All comments default to 'pending' and require admin approval before appearing publicly.

moderationStatus.description: Named moderationStatus, not status — Strapi 5's Admin panel has a core bug (strapi/documentation#2293) where a custom field literally named 'status' collides with its own internal draft/publish status concept, on any content type, breaking both display and editing of the field in the Admin UI regardless of draftAndPublish settings.
